text: Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run,  Lovely length delivery outside off, the outswinger and Rohit Sharma feels for it outside off, does well not to nick off. It moved away just enough to beat the bat
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, fullish outside off, Rohit Sharma gets forward and across to defend solidly to backward point
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, short of length around off, Rohit Sharma goes on the back foot and punches it back to Jacob Duffy's left, who bends down and stops it
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, , good length and down leg, Rohit Sharma flicks and misses, called a wide as there's a bit of excitement among the New Zealanders for a caught behind
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, , full and outside off, moves away, Rohit Sharma gets forward and lofts over cover. Reached the pitch of it and did loft nicely, nice way to get off the mark
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, length delivery on middle, Rohit Sharma gets right behind the line to defend it back down the track

Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, short of length outside off, shapes away, Rohit Sharma goes on the back foot to cut and mistimes it to his right. Tried to hit it too hard and the slowness of the pitch foiled his timing
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, fullish outside off, shapes away a tad, was close to a wide as Ruturaj Gaikwad lets it go and the ump goes with the bowler this time

Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, , thick outside edge and flies wide of 2nd slip. Wel wide in fact. It's a length delivery on off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward to defend, hard hands and the outside edge would've been an easy catch for either third or fourth slip. Instead it's four to India
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, goes for the yorker on off, angled in, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and drives it back to Matthew Fisher. Took it on the full

Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, , full on middle, too straight and that's nicely clipped away. Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and flicks nicely through the vacant mid-wicket area. He plays that shot well and it's the second four of the over
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, short of length on off, angled in, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot to defend to cover. Right behind that

Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, full outside off, shapes away, Ruturaj Gaikwad with a nice square-drive, but picks out backward point. Either side of the fielder and that was four. He timed that did Gaikwad

Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, 3 runs, Rohit Sharma stands tall and punches the back of a length delivery outside off, nice high elbow and beats backward point who dives to his right, cover-point chases and keeps it to three
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, length delivery and angled in on middle, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot and turns it to mid-wicket
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, short of length outside off, shapes away a tad, left alone

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, 2 runs, fullish outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward to drive and it's a punchy shot, wide of cover. Santner chases from mid-off, slides and cuts it off. Should've been a third, but Rohit Sharma is not interested

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, fullish and targetting the front pad, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and across to clip to the left of mid-wicket, Foxcroft dives but can't it cut off, mid-on though is there and they don't take the run

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, , dug in short outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad bends his back and sways away to leave. It's a front foot no-ball even as the players were ready for the next over. A free-hit coming up for Gaikwad next. That is a tight call as Duffy had something behind the line. Poor call from the third ump

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, 1 run, short outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot and pulls, the top-edge flies to fine-leg and Fisher knows it's a free-hit so doesn't go for the catch, keeps it to one
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, short of length outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot and defends to cover
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, lovely cover-drive with a high elbow but Ruturaj Gaikwad finds short cover. Full outside off, Gaikwad with a punchy drive off the front foot
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, short of length outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot to defend to backward point. Solidly behind that
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, goes wide of the crease and angles the good length delivery into middle, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and defends to mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, 1 run, fullish outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and times the drive to the left of cover-point, a fumble and that allows the single
Matthew Fisher to Rohit Sharma, no run, length and angled into middle and off, Rohit Sharma gets forward to drive and times it nicely, picks out mid-on
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, length delivery just outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad with a slight shuffle across, defends it back
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, back of a length outside off, shapes away, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot to cut and mistimes it to backward point
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, leg byes, 1 run, short of length and sliding down leg, Ruturaj Gaikwad flicks and misses, off the thigh pad for a legbye

Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, short on off, Rohit Sharma goes on the back foot to pull, is early into the shot. Toe-ends it and he's lucky that it didn't go up in the air. Lands miles short of first slip. He has a look at the bat after playing that
Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, short of length outside off, Rohit Sharma goes on the back foot and punches to short cover

Jacob Duffy to Rohit Sharma, no run, short of length outside off, shapes away, Rohit Sharma hops to cut that and he has found the bottom of the bat, rolls to backward point. He grimaces as he looks at the bottom of the bat
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, 1 run, full outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward and shows the full face of the bat to play a punchy drive wide of mid-off for one
Matthew Fisher to Rohit Sharma, no run, full and angled in on off, Rohit Sharma gets forward to drive to mid-off. Didn't time that again

Matthew Fisher to Rohit Sharma,  Caught by Dean Foxcroft!! Gone. Rohit Sharma's struggle is over. Length delivery on off, may have stopped on him a touch, he flicks and doesn't keep it down. A simple catch for mid-wicket and Foxcroft takes it easily. A cheer for Kohli who comes in next as Rohit walks off probably the last time on New Zealand soil in Indian colours.
Matthew Fisher to Virat Kohli, 1 run, full and angled in on off, targetting the front pad, Virat Kohli flicks and it's a thick inside edge to fine-leg. Streaky way to get off the mark
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, short of length just outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes on the back foot and punches nicely to cover-point. Loud call of "no" to Virat Kohli
Matthew Fisher to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, good length and hard length on off, hits the pitch hard, Ruturaj Gaikwad is right behind that as he defends to short cover
Jacob Duffy to Virat Kohli, 2 runs, short outside off, Virat Kohli goes on the back foot and pulls, gets it down and beats mid-wicket's dive to his left. Mid-on chases and keeps it to two
Jacob Duffy to Virat Kohli, 1 run, oh! Extra bounce on off, short of length and angled in, Virat Kohli is squared up by the bounce and the thick leading-edge flies to where a
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, 1 run, short of length on middle, Ruturaj Gaikwad nudges it in front of mid-on and calls Virat Kohli through for a quick single
Jacob Duffy to Virat Kohli, 1 run, short of length outside off, Virat Kohli goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to run it down to third man
Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, no run, fullish outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward to push and it hits him high on the bat, rolls to short cover

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad, , nice pull shot. Short outside off, looked like Ruturaj Gaikwad was waiting for it, goes on the back foot and pulls up and over the mid-wicket fielder, one bounce over the ropes
Matthew Fisher to Virat Kohli, no run, short of length and rising outside off, Virat Kohli goes on the back foot and pushes it to backward point. Got on top of the bounce
Matthew Fisher to Virat Kohli, no run, short and pacy outside off, left alone and Tim Seifert leaps a little to collect. The height is just fine on this

Matthew Fisher to Virat Kohli,  Caught by Tim Seifert!! 145kph, Virat Kohli too goes for a cheap score. It's a short delivery outside off, Kohli slashes and the top-edge flies, but not over Tim Seifert who goes to his right and leaps a little to take it with two hands. Kohli shakes his head as he wants to have a look at the replay on the big screen - similar to Rohit. Stunned silence among the many Indian fans who have turned up to watch Ro-Ko - both of whom have fallen early on. A smile on Matthew Fisher's face who now has two.
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, no run, short of length and angled in on middle, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and pushes it to mid-on
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, no run, short of length and angled in on off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and punches to the left of mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, , short and wide outside off, too high as Shreyas Iyer lets it go. Called a wide. Called as two for the over
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, no run, full on off, angled in, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to drive to mid-off

Jacob Duffy to Ruturaj Gaikwad,  Caught by Tim Seifert!! Jacob Duffy has his first. The wobble-seam delivery and it's on a fullish length, it nips back in and Ruturaj Gaikwad gets forward to drive, the thick inside edge is found and Tim Seifert takes a nice catch diving to his left. India in familiar trouble once again in Mount Maunganui. Till he was there, he looked good but that was a loose shot away from the body.
Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, no run, short and angling away from the left-hander, good delivery and a good leave
Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, no run, good length on middle, bit of extra bounce, Axar Patel gets forward to defend, hit high on the bat as he takes the bottom-hand off. Rolls to point
Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, no run, what a ball. Axar Patel is opened up totally. Length delivery on leg-stump, then seams away to square Axar up, lucky that he didn't outside edge that. Just
Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, 2 runs, tough chance and  Full on the legs, Axar Patel flicks and doesn't keep it down. Foxcroft leaps and tips it over the bar with two hands. That didn't stick
Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, 1 run, short of length and down leg, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and nudges to the left of square leg for a quick single
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, short of length on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot to defend to cover
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, fullish outside off, angling away from the left-hander, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and mistimes it to mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, short of length outside off, angling away from the left-hander, Axar Patel lifts his bat and lets it go
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, wide of the crease and dug in short at Axar Patel who goes on the back foot and fends it down. Did well not to fend it straight up, well in front of gully
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, again wide of the crease and dug in short on leg-stump, Axar Patel this time goes on the back foot and gets right behind the line to defend it down

Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and it goes so quickly towards the left of Matthew Fisher who barely had any time to react. Hits the left hand and goes down. Again
Jacob Duffy to Shreyas Iyer, no run, length delivery and angled in on middle, Shreyas Iyer flicks early and it's in the air. Lucky that he didn't hit it straight to the fielder at mid-on

Jacob Duffy to Shreyas Iyer, , beautiful on-drive. That's Shreyas Iyer at his best. Full on middle, Shreyas gets forward and shows the full face of the bat to on-drive it wide of mid-on. That should make him more confident

Jacob Duffy to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run,  Fullish outside off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to drive and the thick outside edge flies. Allen is slow to put his hands up. On the reverse-cup and it bursts through. Flew off the bat and that's another catch dropped by New Zealand

Jacob Duffy to Axar Patel, 1 run,  Axar had to go around Jacob Duffy and probably there was even a mini collision between the batter and bowler. Driven to the left of Santner at mid-off who gets across and fires a throw at the bowler's end. Well short with a direct-hit as Axar was desperately trying to get in

Jacob Duffy to Shreyas Iyer, , good one-legged pull. On a short of length outside off, doesn't rise that high, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and pulls wide of mid-wicket. Beats the chase of mid-on
Jacob Duffy to Shreyas Iyer, no run, full outside off, angled in, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to drive, hits the thick outer half and rolls to short cover
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, 1 run, fullish outside off, Axar Patel leans back and lofts, the thick outside edge flies to third man

Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, , one hand came off the bat and it's four wide of cover and backward point. Fullish outside off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to drive and the face opens. Flies away into the gap
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, , full and down leg, Shreyas Iyer flicks and misses. Tim Seifert dives to his left to take
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, no run, short of length and hard length on off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot to defend to cover
Matthew Fisher to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short around off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and pulls to deep square leg
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, short of length and outside leg, Axar Patel goes on the back foot to defend it to the left of Matthew Fisher

Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, , nice tickle and four. On a short of length and down leg, Axar Patel gets inside the line and flicks it fine to the fine-leg fence for four. Wrong line and Matthew Fisher punished
Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, no run, length delivery angled in on middle and leg, Shreyas Iyer watchfully gets forward to defend it back
Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short of length outside off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and punches with a high elbow, to the left of Santner at mid-off for one
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, , lovely cover-drive. Fullish outside off, Axar Patel gets forward and to the ball, drives on the rise and gets it wide of cover and mid-off
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, 1 run, short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches to the left of mid-off who cuts it off
Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short outside off, Shreyas Iyer controls the pull and gets it down to deep square leg
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, , tennis-ball bounce on this short delivery outside off, left alone and Reiffel at square leg stretches his arms to signal a wide
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, length delivery on middle, Axar Patel gets forward to defend to point
Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, no run, angled in on a good length on middle, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to flick, closes the face of the bat too early, the thick leading-edge rolls to cover
Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short of length and angled in on the thigh pad, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and nudges it wide of mid-wicket for one
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, short of length outside off, from round the wicket, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and cuts hard, but backward point makes a sharp stop
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, back of a length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches to cover-point
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, short of length and rising on off, Axar Patel too rises and goes on the back foot to defend in front of backward point

Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, 1 run, back over the wicket. It's short and at Axar Patel who arches back and lets it fly off the top-edge. Over Tim Seifert and slip, but Duffy comes around from third man to keep it to one
Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, no run, fullish on off, angled in, met with a solid forward defence
Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, no run, short of length outside off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot and punches nicely to cover

Kristian Clarke to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, full outside off, shapes away a tad, Shreyas Iyer gets forward to drive and the thick outside edge flies away where a gully would've been. Was at a catchable height

Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, good stop off his own bowling! Axar is offered a full ball and drives it firmly down the ground, but the seamer gets down quickly and stops it with his left hand

Blair Tickner to Shreyas Iyer,  Caught by Matthew Fisher!! The short ball does the trick. It's short on off, Shreyas Iyer goes on the back foot to pull and doesn't get on top of the bounce. High on the bat and a simple catch to mid-on. Blair Tickner strikes and pushes India further into the mire. Tickner can get deceptive bounce and that was a well-directed short ball.
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length on middle, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and defends to cover
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, back of a length and tight on middle, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and gets right behind the line to defend it back

Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length and angled in on the pads, Ishan Kishan looks to flick and gets an inside edge on to the pad. Looks for a single but Axar Patel is not interested
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, full on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend it back to Blair Tickner. Played it with a full-face
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, tossed up full on off, from round the wicket, Axar Patel gets forward to drive to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up full on leg and middle, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend to cover

Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, hint of drop and turn, tossed up on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward and defends with an open-face to short third man, wants a run but Axar Patel sends him back

Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run,  Axar Patel puts in the dive to make it. It's flicked towards backward square leg and both batters hesitated and stuttered mid-pitch. The throw comes to Tim Seifert, but it's high and Axar puts in the dive to be safe
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, tossed up full on off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, good length on leg-stump, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and tucks it behind square on the leg-side

Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length and nips back in to off, Ishan Kishan is saved by a thick inside edge as he goes on the back foot to defend. The ball rolls to gully after hitting the pad
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, full on off, angled in, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend it back to Blair Tickner. Off the full-face

Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run,  It's a short of length delivery and nips back in a tad to off, Ishan Kishan lifts one leg up to pull, looks like it missed the inside edge and flicked the back thigh. New Zealand were confident but don't review
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, length delivery and angled in on middle, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend to short mid-wicket
Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, , fullish outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward and drives with an open-face, wide of backward point and cover. Runs away to the fence. That is nicely timed

Blair Tickner to Ishan Kishan, no run, fine comeback. Sharp nipbacker and cuts Ishan Kishan in half. Length delivery outside off, big movement off the deck, Ishan lucky not to inside edge that. Flies over the stumps
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, tossed up full on off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive to cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and cuts to the right of cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, flat good length on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and tucks to mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, good length and no turn on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, slower and fuller outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive wide of cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, back of a length and flat outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and cuts to sweeper cover

Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, , superb back foot punch. On a short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches wide of cover. No sweeper cover and it races away. 100 up for India as the crowd cheer

Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, Blair Tickner is down but nothing to worry. After delivery he goes down, length delivery and angled in on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and nudges it to mid-wicket

Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, , searing short delivery and Axar Patel sways away to leave. But it's too high and Wayne Knights signals a wide from cover-point. That was well-directed and at Axar who left it well
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, short of length and tight on middle, Axar Patel stays leg-side of the ball and defends

Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, , he is playing well off the back foot today. On a short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches hard and wide of backward point. Still no sweeper cover and that's the second four of the over
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, no run, good length and tight on off and middle, Axar Patel gets forward to defend to cover
Blair Tickner to Axar Patel, 1 run, short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and cuts to sweeper cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive to long-off
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up full on off, a forward defence to point. "Well bowled boy" is the cry from Tim Seifert to Michael Bracewell
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive and beats the dive of cover to his left
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, flat good length and angled in on middle, from wide of the crease, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and knocks it to mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, tossed up on a length outside off, turns away a tad, Axar Patel gets forward to drive to extra-cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, flat good length on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and makes room slightly to punch wide of extra-cover who can't stop to his right with a dive
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, 1 run, full on middle and off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive, the thick inside edge runs down to fine-leg. So easily could've gone back on
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full on the pads, Ishan Kishan gets forward to flick to deep backward square-leg
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, short of length and tight on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and gets right behind the line to defend
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, leg byes, wide of the crease and short of length down leg, Axar Patel flicks and misses, they take a legbye
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run, full on middle and off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend it back

Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, 3 runs, full outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward and drives hard and wide of Santner at mid-off. He chases and slides to pull it back. Has he pulled it back in time before his left boot hits the cushions. Was the ball away from the hand in time? Yes is the call from the third ump
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, slower and wider outside off, turns away, left alone. "Oh yes, I like that boy" is the encouragement from Tim Seifert to Michael Bracewell
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, flat good length on leg-stump, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and tucks to deep mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, flat good length on middle, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches to the left of point
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, tossed up full on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive and beats Michael Bracewell's dive to his right

Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 2 runs,  He gets forward and tries to loft inside-out to a tossed up delivery around off, the ball drops and turns a tad to take the thick outside edge. Fisher is square at backward point and it flies to his right. They come back for two

Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel,  Caught by Will Young!! Such a soft dismissal and the set batter falls. Axar Patel can't quite believe it. He stands there in disappointment before eventually going off. It's a length delivery outside off, probably held up a touch, Axar goes on the back foot and looks to punch, Young is there at mid-wicket and he is found. Axar failed to keep that down, a wry smile on Michael Bracewell's face. At the halfway stage, India are half their side down. It hit the bottom of the bat as replays show.
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up on a good length outside off, lots of loop, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend to cover
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short and wide outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and cuts hard and straight to sweeper cover
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, from round the wicket. On a length and drifts into middle, Naman Dhir with a forward defence
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, quicker and on leg-stump, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot to defend. "Santner, Santner, lovely" is the cry from Tim Seifert behind the stumps
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up full and quicker on middle, Naman Dhir gets forward to defend

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, flat good length just outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and short-arm jabs the pull wide of mid-wicket. Deep mid-wicket gets across and cuts it off to his left
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, slower and on a length outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot to cut, chops it in front of backward point with no timing
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, slower and tossed up full outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward and opens the face of the bat to drive to sweeper cover
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, flat good length outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and shuffles across to defend to mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward to defend to mid-wicket. Hits the SS bat sticker on the bat
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward to flick to mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, flat good length outside off, goes straight on, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and across to defend it softly
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short and wide outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and cuts hard and straight to sweeper cover
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flat good length and drifts into leg-stump, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and makes room slightly to punch to long-off
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, Ishan Kishan wanted to come down the track, but this is a length delivery outside off, so he goes on the back foot and cuts to sweeper cover
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up full on off, Naman Dhir gets forward and stretches forward to drive to cover
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, wide of the crease and angles a length delivery on middle, met with a solid forward defence

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, , short around off, Naman Dhir pounces. He goes on the back foot and pulls, was in the air but wide of a flying mid-wicket to his left. Hit that hard and that runs away to the deep mid-wicket fence
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up full on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive to extra-cover
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, length delivery outside off, quicker, Ishan Kishan leans back and cuts to deep point
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up full on off, Naman Dhir gets forward to flick to mid-wicket
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, sharp off-break and turns down leg, Naman Dhir glances and misses. Tim Seifert fumbles and much to Dhir's disappointment, Wayne Knights doesn't signal a wide
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward to drive to long-on

Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, , fraction short on middle and leg, Ishan Kishan sinks on one knee, pulls wide of backward square leg's right. Long chase for deep square leg and he doesn't get there despite a dive to his left. Again the over ends with a boundary. Michael Bracewell grimaces in disappointment

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run,  Driven to the left of Mitchell Santner who doesn't see Ishan Kishan stroll out of his crease. Also Ishan slipped, had Santner spotted that and flicked it back, there was a chance of a run-out. Santner with a wry smile and a long look at Ishan
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flat good length on off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and punches to sweeper cover
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, Ishan Kishan wants to use his feet, but this is a length delivery on off, he goes on the back foot and punches to the left of Mitchell Santner
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, quicker and flatter on a good length on off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to glide it to backward point who's very square
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive and it's in the air for a while, but beats mid-wicket who dives to his right
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, slower and on a length outside off, turns away, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and cuts to sweeper cover
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up just outside off - Dhir leans across and defends it to the on-side
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flighted delivery outside off - eased down to long-on for a single
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, , , excellent use of the feet from Kishan - comes down the pitch, makes room and then slaps it wide of cover, the ball was in the air, but it was in the gap as well
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, flighted just outside off - Kishan plays with an open face and defends it to the off-side
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, Bracewell tosses one on off, Kishan comes down the track and eases it down to long-off
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flighted delivery outside off - worked down to long-on for a single

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, , , tossed up slower and wider of off - Ishan Kishan leans into the drive and finds the gap wide of cover. Long chase for Kelly from sweeper cover, drags the ball back in, but it follows him and he's sprawling on the ropes when he pushed it back a second time, given as a boundary
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, no run, flighted delivery on middle and leg - Dhir goes back on the defensive push
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, tossed up and drifting back into the right-hander, clipped into the gap wide of mid-wicket for a single
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, flighted delivery outside off - Ishan Kishan leans across and turns it to the on-side
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, Santner tosses one slower and on off, nudged behind square on the on-side for a single
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 1 run, dragged short and at the stumps - Dhir swivels across and hammers the pull through mid-wicket for a single
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, tossed up slower and drifting into the right-hander - extra bounce as Dhir turns it to the on-side
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, turn and bounce from off - spins into the pad and lobs off the thigh-pad, the ball rolls behind square on the on-side for a single
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up just outside off - driven straight to the fielder at cover
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, slower and wider from Bracewell - made Ishan Kishan reach out on the drive, he isn't in control and spoons it wide of cover for a single
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, no run, Bracewell tosses one just outside off - Dhir leans across and defends it back at the bowler
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flighted delivery outside off - eased down to long-on for a single
Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, , fraction short and at the stumps, Dhir picks the length early, swivels across and then pulls it wide of mid-wicket, comes back for the second

Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir,  Caught by Nick Kelly!! Lovely delivery and Naman Dhir has fallen right into the trap - slowed down the pace on off, gets it to dip onto the right-hander and forces Dhir into the mistake. The right-hander was looking to go inside out with the cover-drive, but the dip forces him to go squarer with the shot, chipped in the air and right down deep cover's throat. Kelly with the catch and India are down to the lower-order.
Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi, no run, tossed up on off, Nabi gets well forward defensively
Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi, no run, flatter and quicker from Santner - Nabi gets back and defends it back at the bowler
Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi, no run, nice bit of flight on off, defended back at the bowler
Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi, , , pushed through quicker by Santner - the drift takes it down leg and Nabi is good enough to get a tickle on the flick, runs away fine and onto the ropes
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up on middle and leg - Kishan was a tad early into the drive, came off the front-edge and bounced in front of the bowler
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, another uppish drive, but the ball drops wide of the diving bowler - pulled the length back and made Kishan reach out on the on-drive
Michael Bracewell to Auqib Nabi, no run, Bracewell tosses one just outside off - spins back in and catches Nabi's inside edge on the defensive push
Michael Bracewell to Auqib Nabi, no run, flighted delivery on off - Nabi stays right back in defence
Michael Bracewell to Auqib Nabi, 1 run, flatter from Bracewell - drifts onto Nabi's pads and it's pulled behind square on the on-side for a single
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, Bracewell tosses one just outside off - a good stride forward as Kishan defended
Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi, no run, tossed up on off, Nabi goes back and defends it to the off-side

Mitchell Santner to Auqib Nabi,  Caught by Finn Allen!! Another soft dismissal and India are in danger of getting bowled out under 50 overs. Wonderful bowling from Santner - tosses one slower and just outside off, it's the drift that's undone Nabi here, he's pushing forward on the drive, the ball drops and he can't control the shot - hits it in the air and straight to cover where Allen gobbles up a safe catch.
Mitchell Santner to Yash Thakur, no run, flighted delivery outside off - Thakur leans well forward in defence
Mitchell Santner to Yash Thakur, no run, pushed through flatter and just outside off - Thakur backs away on the cut and missed
Mitchell Santner to Yash Thakur, no run, flighted delivery on middle and leg - Thakur goes back on the tuck and misses, off the pad and onto the on-side

Mitchell Santner to Yash Thakur,  Caught by Tim Seifert!! Two in the over and Yash Thakur falls for a duck on ODI debut. Was nicely tossed up on off and there's a hint of turn for the New Zealand captain - Thakur's feet hardly moved as he lazily wafted, gets a thick outside edge and Tim Seifert does the rest. Ishan Kishan is in danger of being left stranded at the other end. A double-wicket maiden from Santner as New Zealand strengthen their position.
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, tossed up on off, punched down to long-on and Ishan Kishan is happy to take the single first ball
Michael Bracewell to Mohammed Siraj, no run, Bracewell tosses one wider of off - Siraj leans across and defends it to the off-side
Michael Bracewell to Mohammed Siraj, no run, Bracewell tosses one just outside off - blocked back at the bowler
Michael Bracewell to Mohammed Siraj, no run, tossed up just outside off - a good stride forward as Siraj defended
Michael Bracewell to Mohammed Siraj, no run, very full and just outside off - blocked back at the bowler
Michael Bracewell to Mohammed Siraj, no run, pushed through with a flatter trakectory - Siraj plonks his left leg across and defends it to the on-side. Bracewell is done with the ball for the day,
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, Ishan Kishan comes down the pitch, doesn't get close to the ball and drags it to deep mid-wicket - decides against a single
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up just outside off - defended back at the bowler
Mitchell Santner to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, flighted delivery outside off - Kishan plays late and dabs it fine past the keeper, takes the single now
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, Santner tosses one on middle and leg - defended to the off-side
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, Santner darts one quicker and down leg, clipped straight to the fielder at short fine
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, slower and just outside off - Siraj lunges well forward defensively
Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, banged in short and into the pitch - Kishan swivels across and picks out short fine with the pull

Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, , , on a length and angling back into the left-hander - Kishan leans across, lets the ball come and then brings his wrists into play, shovelling it over long leg for a maximum

Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, Duffy shortens the length outside off, was the slower ball, he rolled his fingers across the seam - Kishan was looking to cut and gets an under-edge onto the keeper
Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, the slower bouncer now, dug into the pitch and pushed across the left-hander, left alone
Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, fuller length delivery and pushed across the left-hander - Ishan Kishan slashes and misses, he's upset with himself for not getting bat onto it

Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, , a one-handed swat and Kishan has got enough power to send it sailing over the ropes at deep backward square leg - back of a length and at the stumps, Kishan swivels across, the bottom-hand came off on impact, but he's got enough power to send it onto the grass banks
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, tossed up on off, Siraj gets well forward in defence
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, 2 runs, pushed through quicker by Santner , slides onto the right-hander and catches Siraj's inside edge, runs away fine and he's back for the second
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, , tossed up and sliding well down leg, left alone and it's a wide
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, very full from Santner - Siraj gets his bat in front of the pad as he defended
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, , very slow and a hint of turn from off, brings Siraj forward and then spins past the outside edge
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, Santner tosses one on middle - Siraj presses well forward as he defended
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, pushed through quicker by Santner - Siraj gets his bat down in time and defends it to the on-side
Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, 113kph - cutter on the length, Ishan Kishan defends it with the inside half of the bat
Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of a length, another slower one at 117kph. Kishan is early into the pull and gets hit around the rib cage

Jacob Duffy to Ishan Kishan,  Caught by Matthew Fisher!! Oh, that's a big wicket for New Zealand at this stage of the innings. Ishan Kishan was batting so well and could have easily added some handy runs down the order, but he will have to walk back . Short and angling across outside off, the left-hander is quick to go for the cut, but the bat face turns and he gets a big top edge that flies straight into the hands of third man.

Jacob Duffy to Arshdeep Singh, , oh hello, that's some way to start the innings! Wow, just clears his front leg, gets away from the ball and smokes this full delivery straight down the ground for a maximum
Jacob Duffy to Arshdeep Singh, 2 runs, a typical response from the seamer as he goes short, and the left-hander mistimes the pull, sending it just over mid-wicket for a couple of runs

Jacob Duffy to Arshdeep Singh, , now, now, Arshdeep Singh is putting on a show!  Arshdeep knew another short delivery was coming, backed away and played the short-arm jab over deep square leg for another maximum
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, drifts in and Mohammed Siraj offers a solid block
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, fullish on the middle and leg, Mohammed Siraj gets forward in defence

Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, 2 runs, now Siraj says it's my turn as he plants his knee and sends this tossed-up delivery outside off over mid-on. Doesn't get the timing right, but gets enough on it to clear the inner circle
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, no run, gives it a lot of air outside off, Mohammed Siraj leaves it alone
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, , Fisher takes a brilliant catch at long-off  before managing to get rid of the ball. This was floated up, and Siraj got a decent bit of bat on it
Mitchell Santner to Mohammed Siraj, , these are all handy runs for India as Mohammed Siraj sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket and collects four more

Jacob Duffy to Arshdeep Singh,  Bowled!!  Duffy gets his third wicket, and it's another slower one that does the trick. Arshdeep moves back once again, and this seems like an off-cutter on the stumps. The left-hander tries to open the bat face and guide it fine, but the ball whistles past the bat and disturbs the timbers.
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, 130kph, comes back in off a length, with the line on the stumps. Young tucks it away to backward square leg and gets off the mark with ease
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, hint of inward movement but the line is well outside off, Tim Seifert is happy to leave it alone as the ball dies in front of the keeper
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, good inward movement once again, but Seifert does well to play it late, allowing the ball to come in before knocking it towards mid-on
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, pad-lined and on the length, Tim Seifert clips it to square leg
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, misses out! A half-volley angling across outside off, and the right-hander powers the drive straight to the fielder at cover
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, pulls his length back, with the ball curling in from outside off. Seifert stands tall and punches, but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a single

Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, huge appeal for a possible strangle down the leg side as Kishan dives to his left and takes the catch. There was a noise, but it might have come off the pad. India have decided to go for the review. Comes in sharply from short of a length as the right-hander misses the clip. Sonic confirms there is no bat involved, and the ball has . India lose a review

Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, 1 run, hops to negotiate the length delivery moving in and gets an inside edge that just evades the stumps. He is late with his block and almost ends up dragging it back onto the stumps
Mohammed Siraj to Will Young, no run, good bounce and sharp movement away from the right-hander, who does well to get his bat out of the way and leave it for the keeper
Mohammed Siraj to Will Young, no run, Will Young takes a step forward but sees the line outside off and shoulders arms
Mohammed Siraj to Will Young, no run, Siraj is getting good shape away from the right-hander, but he will need to make the batters play. This one is also well outside off and comfortably left alone

Mohammed Siraj to Will Young, 2 runs, Too straight from Siraj, drifting onto the pads, and Young tickles it fine towards fine leg. Arshdeep moves across and does well to stop it with his boot just in front of the boundary cushions

Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, , shot! Not quite a half-volley, as it moves across outside off from a length. Seifert stands tall, punches it on the up and sends it straight back down the ground for a boundary
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, full and should have been driven straight down the ground, but Seifert mistimes it towards mid-on. He's not too pleased with himself
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, gently works this to the right of mid-on and moves to the other end
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, 134kph, holds its line but is very full. Young presents a straight bat and eases it towards mid-off
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, slants across with the angle outside off. Young goes for the cut but ends up chopping it into the point region
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, , that's not a great delivery! A half-volley on the pads, and Young leans into it and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. His first in the innings
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, Tim Seifert stays on the back foot and pushes this length delivery back to Siraj
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, no movement on this one as Tim Seifert offers a full face of the bat as the ball rolls to the right of Siraj
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, 135kph, strays down the leg side as the ball continues to angle across. The right-hander fails to connect with the clip
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, , wow, take that! Seifert charges down the track, gives himself a bit of room and whips the drive through cover for a
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, , down the leg side once again as it angles further away from Tim Seifert , and the umpire signals wide
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, hint of away movement off the length outside off, Tim Seifert is careful - left alone
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, 1 run, full and outside off, and the right-hander drives to the left of mid-off for a quick single
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, length delivery angling into the pads, Tim Seifert eases it to mid-on before moving to the other end
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, , short of a length, but it slants down the leg side, and the umpire stretches his arm to signal wide
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, stays a tad low off the length outside off, Will Young punches it to point
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, really good bowling! It curves away nicely off the length after drawing Young into a forward block, before moving late to whistle past the outside edge
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, this time Young stays rooted in the crease as the ball moves away once again, beating him on the outside edge
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, takes a couple of steps forward and tucks this short of a length delivery towards backward square leg

Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, just to the left of Axar Patel at backward point! Full delivery with some late away movement, which draws an outside edge from Seifert as he drives. Axar throws himself to his left with a big dive but can't quite get to it
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, , , with his front foot twisting slightly on landing. This one is way down the leg side and is called wide
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, , there you go again! Pulls his length back, but the line is way down the leg side.
Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, no run, short of a length, tailing in with the angle at 134kph. Seifert stands tall and offers a solid block

Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert, leg byes, no run, oh, what's happened there? Seifert offers no shot as the ball angles in from short of a length. He thinks it's going down leg, but it strikes him on the thigh pad and rolls towards the short fine-leg region. No run taken, as no shot was offered

Mohammed Siraj to Tim Seifert,  Caught by Yash Thakur!! That's gone straight to the fielder at mid-on, who makes no mistake. Amid his struggles with the landing area and playing his first match of the tour, Siraj has struck early with a much-needed wicket for India. Seifert charges down the track and swings across the line with an agricultural heave, but ends up mistiming it straight to Yash Thakur. He gets his body behind the line and takes a comfortable catch. No timing on that one whatsoever.
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, angling across as Nick Kelly offers a nice block off the front foot

Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, stays low and doesn't carry through to the keeper, but the line is outside off to be left alone. Siraj has his hands on his head, but that was quite far from the off stump
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, 3 runs, plays it late, leaning into the fullish delivery and timing the drive through the cover-point gap for three. Gets off the mark
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, no run, goes round the wicket and drops it short and wide. The left-hander goes for the cut but ends up bottom-edging it through to the keeper
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, no run, fullish with his length on the off, Nick Kelly on the front foot as he defends into the off side
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, no run, Auqib Nabi bowls this length delivery from wide of the crease, and Kelly gets behind the line and defends it solidly to covers

Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, 1 run, back over the wicket and bowls it slightly fuller around off. Kelly defends away from his body and gets a thick outside edge that flies past the slip cordon towards third man
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, takes a couple of steps and drops this length delivery to his left
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, 131kph, gives Young no room to free his arms, bowling a heavy length into the pads. Young deflects it towards square leg
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, length delivery slanting across from over the wicket, Nick Kelly is solid in defence
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, pulls his length slightly back as it continues to angle across, Nick Kelly knocks it into the off side
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, 1 run, just pushes at this length delivery angling across him and gets an outside edge down to third man. Does well to keep his hands soft and not go at it too hard

Mohammed Siraj to Will Young, 1 run, another outside edge! Siraj goes full and gets the ball to hold its line. Young moves across slightly and looks to punch with the full face of the bat, but gets an edge that flies through the vacant gully region
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, puts in a bit of extra effort and drops it short. Young goes for the pull but misses and is struck on the shoulder
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, full on the stumps, Nick Kelly is happy to defend
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, no movement on this fullish delivery as Young gets behind it and defends with the full face of the bat
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run,  as Young goes for a swipe at this length delivery. It shapes away from him and misses the off stump
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, tad short of a good length, Will Young stays on the back foot and defends it into the off side
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, nips in sharply, but the length is short enough to give Young time to get onto the back foot and dead-bat it into the surface

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, five dots in a row! Stays low off a length as Young goes for the cut and probably gets it off the bottom part of the bat, with the ball dropping just to the left of the stumps
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, "yeh wali bola tha," says Ishan Kishan from behind the stumps as Nabi goes fullish on the stumps and Young eases it towards mid-on.
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, banged into the middle of the pitch as Kelly manages to sway out of the way. Kishan leaps and collects it over his head
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, , just extends his arms as Kelly is offered width on this short delivery and slaps it through extra cover for a boundary
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, angling across well outside off, Nick Kelly lets it go through to the keeper
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, no run, comes round the wicket and delivers a pinpoint yorker on leg. The left-hander does well to jam it out

Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, , tries the same again but ends up serving a half-volley just outside off. The left-hander creams the square drive through the point region for a gorgeous boundary and holds the pose
Mohammed Siraj to Nick Kelly, 1 run, plays it late as Kelly opens the bat face to a delivery angling across him and steers it past backward point for a single
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, , banged in short by Nabi, but it sails high over Kelly's head, called as a wide
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, no run, Nabi shortens the length on off, defended back at the bowler
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, 1 run, short of a length and pushed across the left-hander, cut crisply to deep point for a single
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, short of a good length and on off, tucked into the gap past square leg for a single
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, 1 run, pitched up by Nabi, Kelly inside halves the drive through mid-wicket for a single
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, back of a length and well wide of off - steered square on the off-side for a single
Auqib Nabi to Nick Kelly, no run, banged in short and pushed across the left-hander - Kelly sways away from the line and lets it go
Yash Thakur to Will Young, no run, he takes a tumble on the followthrough, but this is a decent start - hit the seam outside off and got sme extra bounce, hit high on the bat as Young defended
Yash Thakur to Will Young, , , on a good length and well wide of off, draws a loose drive from Young and finds the edge, flies through the vacant slip cordon and beats the fielder at third man

Yash Thakur to Will Young, , on a good length and just outside off - defended to the off-side. Thakur has flicked the stumps with his ankle during the bowling action and it's called as a no-ball. Free-Hit coming up
Yash Thakur to Will Young, 1 run, Thakur goes full and wide of off - Young reaches out and drives it through cover for a single
Yash Thakur to Nick Kelly, no run, short of a good length and angling into the left-hander, tucked off the back-foot to the on-side

Yash Thakur to Nick Kelly, 1 run, on a good length and just outside off - Kelly inside halves the drive towards mid-on and calls for a quick single. Shreyas swoops and shies at the bowler's end - a direct hit would've been close
Yash Thakur to Will Young, no run, tad fuller and just outside off - Young prods across and defends it to the off-side
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, 1 run, fuller length delivery outside off - driven into the gap wide of cover for a single
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, on a good length and well wide of off - driven off the back-foot to backward point. Axar fumbles and allows a single
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, fraction fuller and just outside off - Kelly plays away from his body and inside edges the drive back at the bowler
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, tad fuller and just outside off - driven on the rise and straight to the fielder at mid-off
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, banged in short and at the left-hander - Kelly drops his wrists and sways away from the line
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, 1 run, short and at the left-hander- Kelly swivels across, rolls his wrists and pulls it down to long leg for a single
Yash Thakur to Nick Kelly, no run, , that's a corker from Thakur - came from round the wicket and got one to nip back with the angle, past Kelly's inside edge and bounced over the stumps
Yash Thakur to Nick Kelly, no run, tad fuller and in that channel around off - a half-forward Kelly defends it to the on-side
Yash Thakur to Nick Kelly, 1 run, short and into the body, Kelly hops across and tucks it behind square on the on-side for a single
Yash Thakur to Will Young, no run, fuller length delivery on off, punched back at the bowler - Thakur gets his left hand and makes a good stop
Yash Thakur to Will Young, no run, Thakur keeps it full and just outside off - punched to the left of Kohli at cover
Yash Thakur to Will Young, no run, on a good length and just outside off - steered with an open face to backward point
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, short and rising outside off, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot and slashes, misses. Flies over the top-edge
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, short of length outside off, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot and cuts, mistimes it to backward point
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, no run, short of length and tight on off, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot and pushes it to backward point
Arshdeep Singh to Nick Kelly, 1 run, short on off, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot and swivels to pull to deep square leg
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, short and an audible grunt from Arshdeep Singh as he delivered that with effort. Will Young ducks
